title: 5 Excel Tasks AI Does in Seconds (Copy These Prompts)
short_title: 5 Excel tasks AI does in seconds
description:
Five everyday Excel jobs that used to take ages, done in seconds with a free AI chatbot. Copy the prompts and formulas:

1. Pull first names from full names
2. Count anything (COUNTIF)
3. Remove duplicates (UNIQUE)
4. Percentage change
5. Turn numbers into a chart
Bonus: highlight overdue dates automatically

Works in Excel and Google Sheets, with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any free AI chatbot.

Subscribe to Work Hacked for a new work shortcut every week.

This video uses AI-generated narration and visuals.

#excel #AItools #productivity

scenes.narration: These five Excel tasks used to take me ages. Now AI does each one in seconds, and I'll give you the exact prompts so you can copy them.
All you need is any free AI chatbot, like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Every formula here works in both Excel and Google Sheets.
Task one. Pull first names out of full names. Imagine a list of five hundred customers. Doing this by hand would take forever.

screen.user: Full names are in column A, like Sarah Johnson. Give me a formula that returns just the first name.

scenes.narration: Put it in the first row and drag it down. Every first name appears instantly.
Task two. Count things. How many invoices are paid? How many orders came from one city? Just ask.
Task three. Remove duplicates. If the same name shows up again and again, one formula gives you a clean list with each name only once.
Task four. Percentage change. Did sales go up or down from last month, and by how much? Ask AI, and format the cell as a percentage.
Task five, and this is the one people love. Turn your numbers into a chart. Ask AI which chart fits your data, and the exact steps to make it.

screen.user: I have monthly sales in columns A and B. Which chart should I use, and how do I make it in Excel?
screen.ai: Use a column chart. Select A1 to B5, go to Insert, then Column Chart.

scenes.narration: A few clicks later, your boring table becomes a chart that anyone can understand at a glance.
Bonus tip. Ask AI to highlight problems for you, like overdue dates, using conditional formatting.

screen.user: How do I make dates in column D turn red if they are before today?
screen.ai: Select column D, go to Conditional Formatting, use a formula rule: =$D2<TODAY(), and choose red fill.

scenes.narration: And remember, if any formula gives an error, paste the error back into the chat. AI will usually tell you exactly what to fix.

screen.ai: One of the cells probably has text instead of a number. Check for spaces or letters.

scenes.narration: Before you trust any formula, test it on a copy of your file, and check a few results by hand.
So, five tasks. First names, counting, removing duplicates, percentage change, and charts. All in seconds.
